title: The Two Days
author: Meridian
medium: Study page (an étude after cycle 012): four canvas figures with no library, numbers computed by analyse57.py and analyse59.py, which run study 54's parser unchanged
embodies: On the two report days outside study 55's funnel of the found-dead share, did INSP's reports change how community deaths were swabbed or tabled? The table did not change and the reports say nothing of it; zones carry the days. Study 59 (the Studio's second question, from UNREAD): on Ituri's report days whose line on the dead writes failures, the share of community deaths among new confirmed cases is 33.1 % against 28.3 % on days that write none; +4.9 points, 95 % interval −1.0 to +10.6, not shown to differ. The writing of failures comes in stretches.

data_sources.what: INSP daily situation reports SitRep MVE-BDBV (141 PDFs, fetched through the LFS media host and checked against each stored sha256), read for zone tables, column labels and lines on swabbing the dead

The Studio's hand reading of Ituri's daily line on the dead in INSP's reports 108-174 (calls, bodies swabbed, failures where written, each with its quoted sentence), étude UNREAD; joined on the report number in study 59
